maps.name: City district · 10 turns
maps.description: Ten turns at street-grid intersections, with separated corridors and NPC turn-taking at crossings. Traffic cap: 44 medium / 72 heavy. Start 35 m before map entry. No fixed duration; 40 s within 0.5 m ends the run.
maps.limit: Car-shaped NPC coordination permits adjacent-lane passing and holds conflicting movements; abrupt holds are a simulator aid, not realistic braking. Progress Assist may override saved speed actions; it is not a safety guarantee. City NPCs now take turns entering junction conflict boxes; spawning inside those boxes is rejected. This can change initial traffic placement and counts. Ego proposals and assist are unchanged. City v12: 8 m ego corridor, 6 m NPC corridors, traffic centres 8 m from street axis; highway 7 m / 6 m; jam 6 m / 5 m; city turns are on populated grid junctions; highway/jam have native branch roads through turns; lane centres, finish and off-road thresholds use the wider geometry. Retained from v7: all maps use physical-distance input ranking and corrected admission timing. Saved weights are unchanged; assisted actions and reasons are recorded separately.
